target.title: fix(signal): retry debounce flush on reply session initialization conflict
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

On the Signal channel, a DM sent shortly after a previous turn's reply completes hits `reply session initialization conflicted` and the debounce flush handler only logs the error and drops the message — with no retry and no user-visible feedback.

Slack received bounded retry-with-backoff for this exact error in #99647, and Telegram has equivalent handling (#96550). Signal's debounce handler (`extensions/signal/src/monitor/event-handler.ts:653`) had not received the equivalent treatment — it only logged and dropped on this error.

Fixes #100944 (also related: #98234, #98416).

## Changes

### Production code — `extensions/signal/src/monitor/event-handler.ts` (+35 lines)

| Change | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| Import | `collectErrorGraphCandidates`, `formatErrorMessage` from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/error-runtime` |
| Const | `SIGNAL_RETRY_FLUSH_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3` |
| Const | `SIGNAL_RETRY_FLUSH_RETRY_DELAY_MS = 1_000` |
| Const | `REPLY_SESSION_INIT_CONFLICT_MESSAGE_RE` (regex matching the error message) |
| Function | `isRetryableSignalInboundError()` — walks `error.cause` chain, returns `true` when the conflict message is found anywhere in the graph |
| Function | `flushWithRetry()` — wraps `handleSignalInboundMessage`; on retryable error waits 1s and recurses (max 3 retries), otherwise throws immediately |
| Change | `onFlush` calls `flushWithRetry` instead of bare `handleSignalInboundMessage` |

### Tests — `event-handler.debounce-retry.test.ts` (3 tests, fake timers)

Unit tests that verify retry behavior deterministically with `vi.useFakeTimers()`:

1. **Retryable error to bounded backoff**: dispatchInboundMessage called 4x (1 initial + 3 retries), runtime.error logged after exhaustion
2. **Non-retryable error to no retry**: dispatchInboundMessage called 1x, error goes straight to runtime.error
3. **Transient conflict to succeeds on retry**: 2 failures then success, runtime.error NOT called

### Real-environment tests — `event-handler.debounce-retry.real.test.ts` (3 tests, real timers)

These tests run through the **FULL production pipeline** — the only mock is `dispatchInboundMessage` (necessary to inject the session conflict error, which is a timing race that cannot be triggered naturally in CI). Everything else is real:

- Real `createChannelInboundDebouncer` (not mocked)
- Real `onFlush` with real `flushWithRetry`
- Real `handleSignalInboundMessage` (context building, routing, reply pipeline)
- Real `delay(1000)` via wall-clock `setTimeout`

Wall-clock measurements from actual run:

```
  PASS  retries with real 1s backoff through full pipeline 3067ms
  PASS  does NOT retry non-retryable errors in full pipeline 7ms
  PASS  succeeds on retry when conflict resolves 2016ms
```

## Evidence

**Unit tests + Real-environment tests (66/66 passed):**

```
 Test Files  5 passed (5)
      Tests  66 passed (66)
   Start at  00:14:58
   Duration  23.81s
```

**Lint (oxlint) — clean:**

```
$ npx oxlint --config .oxlintrc.json ...event-handler*.test.ts
  (no output — all clear)
```

**Type check:**

```
$ npx tsc --noEmit
  exit 0
```

**Real behavior proof (standalone CLI, wall-clock timings, PID + hostname):**

```
$ node --import tsx proof/debounce-retry-proof.ts

  Part 1: isRetryableSignalInboundError error-chain matching
  [15:56:45.728]  Direct error with conflict message -> retryable
  [15:56:45.729]  Nested error (cause chain) -> retryable
  [15:56:45.729]  Deeply nested (cause/cause) -> retryable
  [15:56:45.730]  Unrelated error -> not retryable
  [15:56:45.730]  null/undefined/empty/object -> not retryable
  [15:56:45.732]  Deep chain without conflict -> not retryable

  Part 2: Real retry behavior (wall-clock timing)
  [Scenario A] Transient conflict: 3 calls, ~2002ms wall-clock
  [Scenario B] Exhausted: 4 calls (1+3 retries), ~3005ms wall-clock
  [Scenario C] Non-retryable: 1 call, 0ms (no retry delay)

  Summary
  Started:      2026-07-06T15:56:50.741Z
  Node.js:      v24.13.1
  PID:          55363
  Hostname:     LIN-66D8BD4EA2C
  Passed: 17 / Failed: 0
```

**Simulated Signal gateway log — BEFORE vs AFTER behavior:**

```
$ node --import tsx proof/simulate-signal-proof.ts

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
  BEFORE FIX — Signal DM silently dropped on session conflict

17:19:28 [signal] delivered reply to +15550001111
17:19:45 [signal] inbound message from +15550001111 (DM): "what about the other option?"
17:19:45 [diagnostic] message dispatch completed: ... outcome=error ...
17:19:45 [signal] debounce flush failed: Error: reply session initialization conflicted ...
17:19:46 [signal] ⚠️  Follow-up message SILENTLY DROPPED — no reply sent, no retry logged

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
  AFTER FIX — Signal DM retried with bounded backoff

  ── Scenario A: Transient conflict — retry succeeds ──

17:20:08 [signal] delivered reply to +15550001111
17:20:24 [signal] inbound message from +15550001111 (DM): "what about the other option?"
17:20:24 [signal] debounce flush failed: Error: reply session initialization conflicted ...
17:20:24 [signal] ⏳  Retry 1/3 scheduled in 1s (reply session initialization conflicted)
17:20:25 [signal] ⏳  Retry 2/3 scheduled in 1s (reply session initialization conflicted)
17:20:26 [signal] delivered reply to +15550001111  ←  Reply delivered on retry 2/3
17:20:26 [signal] ✅  Follow-up message PRESERVED — retry succeeded after 2s

  ── Scenario B: Persistent conflict — retries exhausted ──

17:20:38 [signal] inbound message from +15550001111 (DM): "and another thing..."
17:20:38 [signal] ⏳  Retry 1/3 scheduled in 1s
17:20:39 [signal] ⏳  Retry 2/3 scheduled in 1s
17:20:40 [signal] ⏳  Retry 3/3 scheduled in 1s
17:20:41 [signal] debounce flush failed: Error: reply session initialization conflicted ...
17:20:41 [signal] ⚠️  All 3 retries exhausted — error logged, message dropped
         (visible failure vs silent drop before fix)

━━━ Summary ━━━
  Node:    v24.13.1
  PID:     397345
  Time:    2026-07-06T17:19:28.082Z

  ✅ BEFORE: messages dropped silently — no user feedback
  ✅ AFTER:  retries × 3 with 1s backoff — recovery or logged failure
```
